title: CC: read-only JNR import and preservation reconciliation
public_pr_body:
Adds a read-only, offline comparison for JNR source and post-import snapshots, with stable identities, exact integer pence, customer balances, payment allocation checks, jobs, numbering and complete supplied Marpet/preservation comparisons. No importer or application behaviour changes.

Assumption: CC supplements the existing owner's reconciliation/import tools; a reviewer supplies complete independently extracted snapshots. Half-to-even is provided for calculated rational source values, never to round imported invoice totals. Missing exports, negative invoice allocations and incomplete protected inventories refuse rather than guessing.

Checks: 35 focused unit tests pass, 0 failures, 0 skips; typecheck and changed-file ESLint pass. No real data, SQL, database, browser or cutover proof. Snapshot origin and completeness, live isolation and next-number safety still require independent evidence. Coordination and handover: #271. Draft only.

- [x] CC offline comparison and fake-data tests
- [ ] Independent extraction/completeness and real rehearsal evidence
- [ ] Rhys/reviewer decision
